## By country

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}

## libraries
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(stringr)

## load preoutbreak time series data
pre_path: "../data/"
preout <- readRDS(file.path(pre_path, "time_series_preoutbreak_extraction_public_apr_2025.rds"))

location_tr <- preout %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(
    loc_start_week = min(TL),
    loc_end_week   = max(TR),
    loc_tr_weeks   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## load alert evaluation at different delays

eval_all <- lapply(0:24, function(dw){

  #file_path <- paste0("../../main_ecl_dec2024/outputs/evaluation_cases_dw", dw, "_ew52.rds")
  file_path <- paste0(pre_path, "evaluation_cases_dw", dw, "_ew52.rds")

  df <- readRDS(file_path)

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(location = str_trim(location)) %>%
    left_join(location_tr %>% mutate(location = str_trim(location)), by = "location") %>%
    mutate(
      ## intended evaluation window is 52 weeks (364 days)
      evaluation_end_date = evaluation_start_date + 364 - 1,

      ## observed end date (censor at available data)
      observed_end = pmin(evaluation_end_date, loc_end_week),

      ## Number of observed days (inclusive)
      observed_days = as.numeric(observed_end - evaluation_start_date + 1),

      ## Number of fully observed weeks
      O_weeks = floor(observed_days / 7),

      ## ensure bounds
      O_weeks = pmax(O_weeks, 0),
      O_weeks = pmin(O_weeks, 52),

      ## censored weeks
      censor_weeks = 52 - O_weeks,
      censor_weeks = pmax(censor_weeks, 0),

      prop_eval_missing = censor_weeks / 52,

      delay = dw,
      country_code = str_split(location, "::", simplify = TRUE)[,2],
      alert_def = str_extract(alert_id, "^a(\\d+)") %>%
        str_remove("^a") %>%
        as.integer()
    )

  return(df)
})

eval_all <- bind_rows(eval_all)
## save object to be used in the rest of the pipeline
saveRDS(eval_all, file = file.path(pre_path, "evaluation_time_censoring.rds"))

## plot
summary_combined <- eval_all %>%
  group_by(alert_def, country_code, delay) %>%
  summarise(
    n_alerts = n(),
    avg_prop_missing = mean(prop_eval_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_complete = mean(prop_eval_missing == 0, na.rm = TRUE), ## fraction fully covered
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## 1 plot per alert definition
alert_defs <- sort(unique(summary_combined$alert_def))

combined_plots <- lapply(alert_defs, function(a){
  
  df_summary <- summary_combined %>% filter(alert_def == a)
  
  df_points <- eval_all %>% filter(alert_def == a)
  
  ggplot() +
    
    ## individual alert points with proportion of evaluation period missing
    geom_jitter(data = df_points,
                aes(x = delay, y = prop_eval_missing),
                width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.3, color = "grey") +
    
    geom_line(data = df_summary, aes(x = delay, y = prop_complete, color = "Proportion complete"), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(data = df_summary, aes(x = delay, y = prop_complete, color = "Proportion complete"), size = 2) +
    geom_line(data = df_summary, aes(x = delay, y = avg_prop_missing, color = "Average missing proportion"), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(data = df_summary, aes(x = delay, y = avg_prop_missing, color = "Average missing proportion"), size = 2) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0,1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Proportion complete" = "steelblue",
                                  "Average missing proportion" = "red3")) +
    labs(
      x = "Implementation delay (weeks)",
      y = "Proportion / Missing fraction",
      color = "",
      title = paste0("Alert definition a", a)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~country_code) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
})

for (i in 1:length(combined_plots)){
  print(combined_plots[[i]])
}


```

## All countries

```{r}

summary_combined_all_countries <- eval_all %>%
  group_by(alert_def, delay) %>%
  summarise(
    n_alerts = n(),
    avg_prop_missing = mean(prop_eval_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_complete = mean(prop_eval_missing == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

alert_defs <- sort(unique(summary_combined_all_countries$alert_def))

combined_plots_all_countries <- lapply(alert_defs, function(a){
  
  df_summary <- summary_combined_all_countries %>% filter(alert_def == a)
  df_points  <- eval_all %>% filter(alert_def == a)
  
  ggplot() +
    
    ## individual alert-level missingness (all countries)
    geom_jitter(
      data = df_points,
      aes(x = delay, y = prop_eval_missing),
      width = 0.2, height = 0,
      alpha = 0.1,
      color = "lightgrey"
    ) +
    
    ## summary lines
    geom_line(
      data = df_summary,
      aes(x = delay, y = prop_complete, color = "Proportion complete"),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_summary,
      aes(x = delay, y = prop_complete, color = "Proportion complete"),
      size = 2
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = df_summary,
      aes(x = delay, y = avg_prop_missing, color = "Average missing proportion"),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_summary,
      aes(x = delay, y = avg_prop_missing, color = "Average missing proportion"),
      size = 2
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Proportion complete" = "steelblue",
        "Average missing proportion" = "red3"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Implementation delay (weeks)",
      y = "Proportion / Missing fraction",
      color = "",
      title = paste0("Alert definition a", a, " (all countries)")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
})

for (i in seq_along(combined_plots_all_countries)) {
  print(combined_plots_all_countries[[i]])
}



```
